summary: A three-tab app with a Home feed of cards, a Search tab for finding cards, and a Profile tab for the user's details and preferences. Cards and profile data are stored on the device so they remain after relaunch.

screens.title: Search
screens.purpose: Search cards by text and see matching results.

screens.title: Profile
screens.purpose: Shows the user's name, avatar and app preferences.

screens.title: Card
screens.purpose: Full view of a single card opened from Home or Search.

capabilities.reason: Keeps cards and the profile on the device across relaunches.
The Search tab needs a searchable text field with results.
Provides 44 point tap targets, Dynamic Type spacing and Reduce Motion support across all tabs.
Tab bar and card icons use SF Symbols.
Card and background colors need light and dark variants.
Lets the user choose a profile photo without library permission.
Lets the user share a card from its detail screen.
The app needs a home screen icon.

features: Tab bar with Home, Search and Profile
Tap a card to open its detail
Search cards by title and body
Editable profile with name, bio and photo
System, Light or Dark appearance setting
assumptions: No sign-in or server is needed, so all content is local with sample cards.
Search filters the on-device cards only.
The feed content is placeholder until the user supplies real content.
Only one profile exists on the device.
